exposure: Birth weight category (low birth weight 1501-2500gm, very low birth weight 1001-1500gm, extremely low birth weight <1000gm)
cohort: The study included 300 low birth weight infants from Makkah, Saudi Arabia, born between October and December 2012, divided into three groups based on their birth weight (<1000g, 1001-1500g, and 1501-2500g).
finding: Low newborn birth weight was associated with deteriorated nutritional status, evidenced by lower anthropometric measures and abnormal biochemical parameters, although complete blood count results did not correlate with birth weight.
cross-section timing: Immediately after birth, for infants born between October and December 2012.
birth_weight: Infants weighing <2500g, categorized as 1501-2500g (low), 1001-1500g (very low), and <1000g (extremely low).
